hero.title: Nursing in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: Enroll in accredited Nursing programs in Mauritius, offering comprehensive clinical foundations, simulation labs, and supervised practical training in modern hospital settings. Benefit from globally aligned healthcare curricula and supportive international student environments.

overview: Nursing in Mauritius for Indian Students can offer exposure to healthcare education in a multicultural environment, with training pathways ranging from assistant-nurse qualifications to professional nursing programmes. For international students, the key considerations are the institution’s recognition, admission eligibility, clinical placements, total costs and professional registration after graduation. Students exploring Nursing in Mauritius for Indian Students should carefully compare available programmes and their professional recognition before making a decision.
